required_interface: RemoteFleetHasher.grind_target_m32 now enforces count % 32 == 0 (same contract as local m32 hashers); fleet slices are whole-epoch aligned
reason: RemoteFleetHasher._slice previously split m32 windows by raw step counts; members receiving a take that was not a whole 32-step epoch ran partial epochs at non-epoch boundaries — coverage gaps, duplicate probes and out-of-window nonces on the exact-winner path. Fixed in mining/remote_hasher.py: slices split whole epochs and a misaligned window raises ValueError at the public boundary. C-side callers of the fleet remote hasher must pass windows that are multiples of 32, identical to the local hasher contract.

required_interface: StratumBridge fail-closed pool-input contract: malformed mining.notify / mining.set_difficulty are dropped and counted in bridge.malformed_messages; handshake raises RuntimeError on malformed mining.subscribe fields; last_job / difficulty retain previous valid state
reason: The bridge previously trusted pool fields by shape: a non-hex notify field crashed mine_job via bytes.fromhex (killing the whole mining loop), a non-numeric set_difficulty killed listen_forever (zombie miner grinding stale jobs), and malformed subscribe fields propagated into every coinbase build. Fields are now wire-validated at ingestion. Consumers (chronus.mla1517.mining stratum_adapter/coordinator) should be aware observable behavior changed: malformed traffic is counted and dropped, never applied.
